name: Seam imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes, one of the Magma King's: leathery skin, short curled horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, teal-tinted skin that flickers at the edges

poses.stand: hovering mid-air on spread bat wings, teal-tinted, its edges faintly glitching like a torn photograph, a thin glowing teal seam in the air at its back
poses.struck: just hit and caught mid-shriek: eyes bulging, mouth stretched open, wings snapped up, body tilted back with cracks of orange light glowing through its skin
poses.dead: vanishing into a small flash of teal light and black soot, only its horns tumbling out

idle.action: hovers, flapping, flickering at the edges

attack.action: snaps both hands out and spits two quick embers, then hovers again

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a yelp, wings crumpling, then recovers

die.action: shrieks, flickers teal, and pops into soot and embers
